text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After school, I spotted Eishin Flash and 
Daiwa Scarlet in front of the school 
building, looking troubled.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... It looks like it's about to start 
raining any second, Flash-san.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"This is quite troublesome. If we have to 
look for an umbrella now, it will delay 
our schedule by more than five minutes."
choice_data_list: Would you like to use this umbrella?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I appreciate the offer, but... Wouldn't 
that leave you getting soaked in the rain?
choice_data_list: I have a folding umbrella with me.
I have my folding umbrella with me, so...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much. Then I shall take you 
up on your kind offer and borrow it.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-san, would you like to go watch 
the Debut Races together with me?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I have an important plan today. Come, 
let us head to the racetrack.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: "Wah!? It really did start raining!"

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Scarlet-san, please come closer to this 
side. Your shoulder will get wet from the 
rain like that.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: U-Um... well then, excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. Sharing an umbrella feels kind of 
ticklish, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"However, your shoulder is still sticking 
out 3 centimeters from under the umbrella, 
Scarlet-san. Please step closer to me."

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes... ...Ahaha, it feels a little warm 
today, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Under the same umbrella, the two huddled 
close, matching each other's stride as 
they walked...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
The rain is letting up. Thank goodness, it 
was only temporary.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Flash-san! The race is about to start 
soon!
choice_data_list:
Come to think of it, what was that 
important plan?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Yes, today is the debut selection race for 
a junior both Scarlet-san and I are close 
with.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
She's an important junior of mine, so I 
came here to cheer her on.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"I wonder if she's alright? Do you think 
she's nervous!?"

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
All we can do now is watch over her. Let 
us believe in that girl.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Ah! It's really starting now...! An 
important selection race... Do your best!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And the race begins.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even beneath the overcast sky, you can 
feel the blazing heat. Young talents clash 
and spark as they tear across the turf.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"Do your best! Pay close attention to your 
lap times! Don't lose your pace...!"

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Pay close attention to your surroundings! 
...D-Don't give up! Hang in there! Put all 
your spirit into it and give it everything 
you've got!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The two juniors take the initiative from 
the start, maintaining a steady pace 
throughout and demonstrating a stable run.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Yes! Yes! She won!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
A-Amazing! That was fantastic! It was such 
a great race development...!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Eeeek! Yay, hooray! We've gotta celebrate!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Eishin Flash and Daiwa Scarlet are 
rejoicing over their junior's victory as 
if it were their own.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sharing the same heartfelt care for our 
junior, I felt an irreplaceable bond 
between us.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much! ...Fufu, but please 
save those words for her.
choice_data_list: We're rivals from here on out!

Today calls for a grand celebration, 
doesn't it!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much! ...Fufu, but please 
save those words for her.
choice_data_list: We're rivals from here on out!

Today calls for a grand celebration, 
doesn't it!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. If she gets a Trainer now, we 
won't be able to let our guard down 
either.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I won't lose! Not to her... and not to 
Flash-san either!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. I'm already looking forward to 
competing with everyone out on the 
racetrack.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
That's true. I need to make lots of her 
favorite foods for her.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I'll help with the cooking too! Ah, why 
don't we bake a cake together as well? 
She'll definitely love it...!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Looks like I'll have to put my best 
skills to work on this one.
